# Visit Colorado Springs

> > Official tourism guide for Colorado Springs and the Pikes Peak region, featuring outdoor adventures, cultural attractions, events, and travel planning resources.

Visit Colorado Springs is the destination marketing organization for Colorado Springs, Colorado, promoting tourism in the Pikes Peak region. The site provides comprehensive information on attractions like Garden of the Gods, seasonal experiences such as Ice Castles in Cripple Creek, outdoor recreation, cultural events through the Cultural Office of the Pikes Peak Region, and local dining and lodging options.

## Key Topics

- Colorado Springs
- Pikes Peak region
- Garden of the Gods
- Ice Castles Cripple Creek
- Old Colorado City
- Cultural Office of the Pikes Peak Region
- Peak Radar
- Winter activities
- Family-friendly attractions
- Outdoor adventures
- Stargazing
- First Friday ArtWalk
- Art exhibitions
- Dog parks
- Hot air balloons

## Travel Guides & Activities

- [Explore Colorado Springs By Land and Air](https://www.visitcos.com/blog/explore-colorado-springs-by-land-and-air): Adventure guide featuring hot air balloons, hiking, biking at Garden of Gods
- [Ice Castles Cripple Creek 2026](https://www.visitcos.com/blog/guide-to-ice-castles): Guide to Ice Castles 2026 experience in Cripple Creek with frozen mazes
- [Stargazing in Colorado Springs](https://www.visitcos.com/blog/stargazing): Best stargazing locations including Space Foundation Discovery Center
- [Top Dog Parks in Colorado Springs](https://www.visitcos.com/blog/top-dog-parks-in-colorado-springs): Guide to fenced off-leash dog parks including Antlers and Bear Creek

- ['Finding Peace'](https://www.visitcos.com/events/finding-peace-2): Mixed media abstract painting exhibition exploring emotion and intuition
